verdict.rationale: Paxos docs show programmatic stablecoin transfer/conversion orchestrations (mint/redeem, asset transfers), beneficiary/recipient handling for crypto transfers, and webhooks for asynchronous event tracking that could support payout status monitoring. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'pay to wallet address or stored recipient' payout endpoint with full status-to-settlement tracking, and the OpenAPI spec probe failed (404), limiting confirmation of endpoint-level detail. Missing for 10: explicit payout-to-wallet/stored-recipient API reference, confirmed OpenAPI schema, and independent/hands-on verification of settlement status tracking.
